title: Complications and management of modified custom-made subperiosteal implants in severely atrophic maxilla and mandible: a retrospective cohort of 211 implants
html: Modified custom-made, additively manufactured subperiosteal implants incorporating guided crestal boneoplasty for abutment housing have re-emerged as a graftless option for selected patients with severe jaw atrophy. This study evaluated the incidence, timing, severity, and management of complications in a large consecutive cohort. A retrospective analysis was conducted on 124 patients who received 211 titanium custom-made subperiosteal implants between 2018 and 2025 at a single maxillofacial surgery unit.
